title: CapStarr-seq protocol
protocol: Extract genomic DNA using a standard method.
Dissolve extracted DNA in water thoroughly.
Dilute required amount of genomic DNA to 20 ng/µL in TE buffer.
Aliquot 100 µL of diluted genomic DNA into 0.65 mL microtubes for shearing.
Keep the tubes on ice for 10 minutes, then vortex and spin briefly.
Place the tubes on the tube holder and start sonication using Diagenode™ Bioruptor® Pico Ultrasonicator with settings: 15 seconds ON, 90 seconds OFF for 7 pulses.
Homogenize AMPure XP beads at room temperature before use.
Adjust the volume of fragmented DNA to 100 µL.
Add 0.75X volume of beads (75 µL) to the DNA sample, mix well by pipetting and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes.
Carefully transfer 73 µL of supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube and discard the beads.
Add 0.5X volume of beads (50 µL) to the collected supernatant, mix well by pipetting and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the tube on the magnetic rack for 5 min.
Carefully remove all supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with freshly prepared 80% ethanol.
Briefly spin, place the tube on the magnetic rack, and completely remove all residual ethanol after the second wash.
Dry the beads at 40 °C until the pellet starts to break, avoiding over drying.
Elute DNA in 102 µL of water.
Transfer exactly 100 µL of the supernatant into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 0.85X volume of beads (85 µL), mix well by pipetting.
Incubate at RT for 5 min.
Place the tube on the magnetic rack for 5 min.
Carefully remove all supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with freshly prepared 80% ethanol.
Briefly spin, place the tube on the magnetic rack, and completely remove all residual ethanol after the second wash.
Dry the beads at 40 °C until the bead pellet starts to break.
Elute DNA in 75 µL of water.
Transfer 73 µL of the supernatant into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Analyze size-selected DNA on Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.

Mix the following components in a 1.5 mL tube for end repair: Size-selected DNA, Phosphorylation Reaction Buffer (10X), T4 DNA polymerase, T4 Polynucleotide Kinase, dNTPs, DNA Polymerase I (Klenow Large Fragment), and sterile water to make a total volume of 100 µL.
Incubate the mixture in a Thermocycler for 30 min at 20 °C.
Clean up the reaction with AMPure XP beads by adding 1.2X volume of beads (120 µL) to the reaction and following the cleanup protocol, eluting DNA in 34 µL of water.
Carefully transfer 32 μl of supernatant from the cleaned-up reaction to a new 1.5 mL tube.

Mix the following components in a 1.5 mL tube for dA-Tailing: End Repaired, Blunt DNA, NEBuffer 2 (10X), Deoxyadenosine 5’-Triphosphate, and Klenow Fragment (3'→5' exo-) to make a total volume of 50 µL.
Incubate the mixture in a Thermocycler for 30 min at 37 °C.
Clean up the reaction with AMPure XP beads by adding 1.2X volume of beads (60 µL) to the reaction and following the cleanup protocol, eluting DNA in 12 µL of water.
Carefully transfer 10 μL of supernatant from the cleaned-up reaction to a new 1.5 mL tube.

Mix the following components in a 1.5 mL tube for adaptor ligation: dA-Tailed DNA, Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer (2X), and NEBNext Adaptor to make a total volume suitable for the next step of library preparation.
Incubate the mixture with Quick T4 DNA Ligase for 15 minutes at 20 °C.
Add 3 μL of USER™ enzyme mix by pipetting up and down, then incubate at 37 °C for 15 min.
Clean up the reaction using AMPure XP beads: add 63.6 µL of bead to the mixture and follow the cleanup protocol.
Elute DNA in 27 µL of water and carefully transfer 25 μL of supernatant to a new tube.
Mix ligated DNA, CapStarr-seq primer mix, KAPA HiFi HotStart Readymix DNA Polymerase, and sterile H2O as specified for a total volume of 50 µL.

Place the PCR tube in a Thermocycler and run the program: initial denaturation at 98 °C for 45 s, followed by 7 cycles of denaturation at 98 °C for 15 s, annealing at 65 °C for 30 s, extension at 72 °C for 30 s, and a final extension at 72 °C for 2 min.
Maintain the tube at 4 °C after PCR program completion.
Clean up the PCR reaction with AMPure XP beads: add 60 µL of bead to the mixture and follow the cleanup protocol.
Elute DNA in 22 µL of water and carefully transfer 20 μL of supernatant to a new tube.
Measure the concentration of DNA with a Qubit dsDNA Kit.
Assess quality of DNA library with Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer using the DNA High Sensitive Kit.
Perform PCR reactions as required to obtain 10-20 µg of DNA for capture.
Start again from step B1 if DNA yield is insufficient.
Construct a home-designed 3 bp resolution oligonucleotide microarray covering desired genomic regions using SureSelect Capture Array technology and eArray tool default settings.
Follow the Agilent SureSelect DNA Capture array protocol from Section 3, steps 1 to 5.
Purify eluted post-capture DNA with AMPure XP beads by adding 1X volume of beads (490 µL) and following the cleanup protocol.
Elute purified DNA in 52 µL of water and carefully transfer 50 μL of supernatant to a new tube.
Set up a PCR reaction by mixing eluted post-capture DNA, Capstarr-seq primer mix, KAPA HiFi HotStart Readymix DNA Polymerase, and sterile H2O in specified volumes.
Place the tubes in a Thermocycler and run at 98 °C for 45 s followed by 20 - 24 cycles of 98 °C for 15 s, 65 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 30 s.
Continue PCR amplification with a final extension step at 72 °C for 2 min and hold the reaction at 4 °C.
Clean up amplified DNA using AMPure XP beads.
Add 60 μL of bead to the reaction.
Follow the clean-up protocol.
Elute DNA in 42 μL of water at the final step.
Transfer 40 μL of the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Measure the concentration of DNA with the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
(Optional) Analyze post-capture DNA library on Agilent 2100 bioanalyzer using DNA High Sensitive Kit.
Perform additional PCR reactions as needed to reach at least 2 μg of DNA for cloning.
Select a set of at least 3 targeted regions and 3 non-targeted regions for qPCR assay.
Set up two series of qPCR reactions using pre-capture amplified DNA library as template.
Set up two series of qPCR reactions using post-capture amplified library as template.
Add 0.5 ng of DNA to the qPCR reaction mix.
Add primer mix (10 μM each) at a volume of 2 μL.
Add Power SYBR at a volume of 10 μL.
Add up to 20 μL of sterile H2O to reach the total volume required for qPCR.
Evaluate target enrichment by measuring ΔCt values.
Incubate the digestion mixture with Plasmid DNA, Cutsmart buffer, and AgeI-HF at 37 °C for 4 – 6 hours.
Purify digested plasmid using QIAquick PCR Purification Kit and elute in 50 µL of water.
Incubate the digestion mixture with Plasmid DNA, Cutsmart buffer, and SalI-HF at 37 °C for 6 – 8 hours.
Prepare an agarose gel at 0.8% in a long tray.
Load digested plasmid on the gel, avoiding overload of plasmid DNA.
Run the gel at low voltage until bands are well separated.
Excise the desired band under UV 365 nm quickly to avoid DNA damage.
Purify linearized plasmid with QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit and elute in 50 µL of water.
Digest 5 µg of plasmid DNA using Cutsmart buffer, NcoI-HF enzyme, and sterile H2O to a total volume of 100 µL.
Purify digested plasmid with QIAquick PCR Purification Kit and elute in 50 µL of water.
Perform 12 In-Fusion reactions using the In-Fusion HD Cloning Kit.
Combine linearized vector, library DNA, In-Fusion enzyme mix, and H2O for each reaction to a total volume of 10 µL.
Incubate reactions for 15 min at 50 °C, then transfer tubes to ice.
Pool all 12 In-Fusion reactions in a 1.5 mL tube.
Purify the pooled In-Fusion reaction with AMPure beads by adding 1X volume of bead and following clean-up protocol.
Elute recombinant plasmid in 22 µL of water, then transfer 20 µL of supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Thaw MegaX DH10B™ T1R Electrocomp™ Cells on wet ice.
Gently tap the thawed cells to mix them.
Add 220 µL of cells to a chilled 1.5 mL tube containing 20 µL of purified recombinant plasmid.
Pipette 20 µL of cell/DNA mixture into a chilled 0.1 cm cuvette and electroporate using 2.0 kV, 200 Ω, 25 μF conditions.
Add 1 mL of Recovery Medium to the cells in the cuvette and transfer the solution to a 15 mL culture tube.
Perform the remaining 11 transformations and pool altogether in the same tube.
Close the tube lid and shake at 225 rpm at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Spread 0.002%, 0.004%, and 0.006% of the total transformation mix on pre-warmed LB plates containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate plates overnight at 37 °C.
Transfer the remaining transformation mix directly to 1 L of LB containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Grow overnight at 37 °C with shaking at 250 rpm.
Count the number of colonies on plates and estimate the number of clones in the whole transformation reaction.
Collect cultured bacteria after 14-16 hours.
Perform 10 Maxipreps using 100 mL of bacteria per one Maxiprep following the manufacturer’s protocol.
Dilute purified plasmid library well in water at a high concentration (~5 µg/µL).
Plate cells one day before transfection at a density to reach 70% - 80% confluence the next day.
Prepare required culture flasks and fill with pre-warmed culture medium.
Count the cell number.
Take an aliquot of 50 x 10^6 cells and wash in pre-warmed PBS.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation and completely remove PBS.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL Buffer R.
Add plasmid library: 25 µg of plasmid library per million cells, so total 1250 µg plasmid library is needed for 50 million cells.
Perform 10 transfections with 5 million cells per transfection using a pulse voltage of 1450, pulse width of 10, and pulse number of 3.
Spread the transfected cells in prepared culture flasks.
Return the cells into a 37 °C, 5% CO₂ incubator.
Collect cells for RNA isolation using the RNeasy Mini Plus Kit 24 hours after transfection.
Homogenize samples using QIAshredder.
Apply DNase-on-column treatment.
Measure total RNA amount with Nanodrop Spectrometer.
Follow µMACS mRNA Isolation Kit instructions to purify mRNA.
Determine purified mRNA concentration by Qubit RNA HS Assay kit.
Prepare a mixture in a PCR tube containing all the mRNA from above, 5 μL of 10X Buffer, 1 μL of DNase I, and up to 50 μL of H₂O for a total volume of 50 μL.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 min then place on ice.
Perform RNA clean-up following the Rneasy Mini Plus Kit protocol.
Quantify final mRNA concentration by Qubit RNA HS Assay Kit.
Prepare the RNA/primer mixture for reverse transcription: Mix 300 ng of mRNA, 1 μL of RT primer (10 µM), 1 μL of dNTP (10 µM), and add sterile H2O to a total volume of 10 µL.
Incubate the RNA/primer mixture at 65 °C for 5 min then place on ice for at least 1 min.
Prepare the cDNA synthesis mix: Mix 2 μL of 10X RT buffer, 4 μL of 25 mM MgCl2, 2 μL of 0.1M DTT, 1 μL of Rnase OUT (40U/ µL), and 1 µL of Superscript III RT (200U/ µL).
Add 10 µL of cDNA synthesis mix to each RNA/primer mixture, mix gently, and collect by brief centrifugation.
Incubate the mixed reaction at 50 °C for 50 min then terminate the reaction at 85 °C for 5 min. Chill on ice.
Add 1 μL of Rnase H to each tube and incubate for 20 min at 37 °C.
Purify the reaction with QIAquick PCR Purification Kit and elute in 50 µL of water.
Measure single-strand cDNA concentration by Qubit® ssDNA Assay Kit.
Prepare a cDNA mixture for 1 reaction with 5 ng of targeted library PCR primer mix and adjust the volume to 50 µL using KAPA HiFi HotStart Readymix DNA Polymerase and sterile H2O.

Prepare an Input Library mixture for 1 reaction with 0.2 ng of plasmid DNA from maxiprep, add targeted input PCR primer mix, and adjust the volume to 50 µL using KAPA HiFi HotStart Readymix DNA Polymerase and sterile H2O.
Place the tubes in a thermocycler and run a program at 98 °C for 2 min.
Cycle through 15 cycles of 98 °C for 20 s, 65 °C for 20 s, and 72 °C for 1 min.
Hold at 72 °C for 2 min after the final cycle.
Keep the reaction tubes at 4 °C post-program completion.
Purify the PCR reaction using a QIAquick PCR Purification Kit and elute in 50 µL of water.
Analyze DNA libraries on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with a DNA High Sensitive Kit.
Perform a PCR reaction to add sequencing indexes to the libraries using NEBNext® Multiplex Oligos for Illumina® (Index Primer Set 1).
Mix the following components: DNA library/Input, 2 ng; Universal primer (25 µM), 2.5 µL; Index primer (25 µM) #, 2.5 µL; KAPA HiFi HotStart Readymix DNA Polymerase, 25 µL; Sterile H2O, up to 50 µL.
Place the tubes in Thermocycler and run: 98 °C for 2 min, followed by 98 °C for 15s, 65 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 30s (10 cycles), then 72 °C for 2 min.
Keep the tubes at 4 °C after cycling.
Add 1X volume of AMPure XP beads to the PCR product and follow cleanup protocol.
Elute DNA in 52 µL of water, carefully transfer 50 μL of the supernatant to a new tube.
Quantify DNA library and Input library on Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer using DNA High Sensitive Kit.
Perform sequencing using an Illumina high-throughput sequencing platform and standard single-end sequencing.
Align sequenced reads to the adequate genome using standard tools.
Elongate each read accordingly to the average size of the library.
For each captured region, quantify the number of Fragment Per Kilobase per Million mapped reads (FPKM) in both Input and CapStarr-seq experiments.
Remove regions where FPKM in the Input sample is below 1.
For each region, compute the FPKM ratio between CapStarr-seq and Input samples.
Determine a threshold for enhancer activity.
If the experiment contains a set of negative controls or randomly chosen regions, then estimate the threshold using a fold discovery rate approach.
If not, estimate the threshold by computing the inflexion point of the ranked FPKM ratios.
